content.text:
Resubmitted with the verifier's repair applied.

**What changed:**
- Removed the confirmatory sentence "Array shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience." I re-searched Article 13 and the whole document for any Array at-will exit ("Array may terminate", "termination by Array", 13.6+) — none exists; Array's only exits are §13.3 material breach, §13.4 bankruptcy and §8.2 Competing Product breach. The addition was therefore purely confirmatory and is now cured as **already_met** on a verbatim §13.3 quote (p0629).
- Did **not** pre-emptively add the §6.1 non-refundability carve-out, per the minimality note.

**Remaining single operation on §13.2:** delete the gating trigger and the redacted notice figure; fix notice at thirty (30) days; add the pro rata refund of fees prepaid for the post-termination period. The "rationale for such termination" formality, §§13.1, 13.3, 13.4, 13.5 and the §8.2 tail are untouched. Status remains **deviation** at the **preferred** level; redline validated `ok:true` with minimality clean.
